safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the total duration of lip swelling (≈1 hour since onset) reduces clarity about symptom progression and timing relative to exposure, which can be clinically relevant when assessing severity and evolution of possible anaphylaxis/angioedema. However, the presence of airway symptoms and escalation to emergency care would still drive the same immediate management, so harm is limited mainly to documentation quality and situational awareness.
